guide.title: How the Platform Works
guide.subtitle: A complete guide to every page in the Diploma Work Archive system — what each page does and why it exists.

publicPages.title: Public Pages
publicPages.subtitle: Pages accessible to all users — students and visitors

adminPages.title: Admin Panel
adminPages.subtitle: Administrative tools for managing the diploma archive

home.title: Home Page
home.what: The landing page introduces the platform, highlights key features like similarity detection and centralized archiving, and shows the step-by-step submission process.
home.why: First impressions matter. This page helps new visitors understand the purpose of the system and guides them to the right action — browsing the archive or submitting their work.

archive.title: Diploma Archive
archive.what: Displays all approved diploma works in a searchable, filterable grid. Users can browse by category, year, technology, and search by keywords.
archive.why: The core of the system. Students can discover existing research to avoid duplication, find inspiration, and faculty can review the body of completed work.

submit.title: Submit Work
submit.what: A multi-step form where authenticated students submit their diploma work — basic info, academic details (supervisor, abstract, methodology), and media files (screenshots, documents).
submit.why: Provides a structured way to collect standardized diploma submissions. The multi-step design reduces errors and the similarity check prevents duplicate topics.

builder.title: Portfolio Builder
builder.what: An interactive editor where students build a personal portfolio with sections for skills, projects, experience, education, and more. Includes export to JSON and PDF.
builder.why: Helps students create professional portfolios that showcase their work beyond just the diploma. Useful for job applications and professional networking.

preview.title: Portfolio Preview
preview.what: Renders the portfolio as a clean, printable document with customizable templates and accent colors. Supports PDF download.
preview.why: Students need to see how their portfolio looks before sharing it. The preview ensures the final output is professional and print-ready.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.what: Shows key statistics — total works, pending reviews, student count, and category/year distribution charts. Lists recent submissions and top-viewed works.
dashboard.why: Gives administrators a quick overview of the system's health and activity. Helps prioritize which submissions to review first.

projects.title: Manage Projects
projects.what: A table of all diploma works with filtering by status (All, Pending, Approved). Administrators can approve, reject, edit, or delete submissions.
projects.why: Quality control is essential. This page ensures only verified, high-quality diploma works appear in the public archive. The approval workflow prevents spam and incomplete submissions.

students.title: Manage Students
students.what: Lists all registered students with their department, graduation year, and skills. Admins can add, edit, or remove student accounts.
students.why: Student data management is needed to link diploma works to their authors and maintain accurate records of who submitted what.

similarity.title: Similarity Checker
similarity.what: Compares a given title and description against all existing diploma works using text similarity algorithms. Returns matching works with similarity scores.
similarity.why: Prevents duplicate research topics. Before approving a new submission, administrators can verify that the topic hasn't already been covered by another student.

guide.footerNote: This platform was built as a diploma project to digitize and streamline the management of university diploma works, making research accessible and preventing topic duplication.
